themes.name: dsh-client-ui-theme
themes.description: Official ThemeRuntime over --dsw-* tokens (static scale + alias semantic layers); light/dark/system. Five sheets: base, design-platform, scrollbar, gradient-shadow-text, shiki. Third-party themes are an extension point, not a product. Not a theme store.

themes.name: dsh-web-ui
themes.description: Third-party plugin/skin collection for the dsh Web UI. Skin center routes around the theme-persistence gap. Also listed in awesome-dsh-plugins.
themes.notes: Not verified as a --dsw-alias-* token override.

themes.name: dsh-deep-whale
themes.description: DSH Web whale-girl skin series (maid-atelier). Theme/skin-shaped third-party listing.
themes.notes: Not verified as a --dsw-alias-* token override.

themes.name: whale-girl
themes.description: DSH Web GUI desktop-pet plugin (QQ pet form): floating companion. Theme/skin-shaped listing.
themes.notes: Not verified as a --dsw-alias-* token override.

themes.name: dsh-qq2006
themes.description: QQ2006 skin plugin: registers a qq2006 theme, mirrors body[data-ds-skin], ships a global skin sheet and assets.
themes.notes: Tagged dsh-skin. Not verified as a --dsw-alias-* token override.

themes.name: dsh-nachoneko-theme
themes.description: Nachoneko (甘城猫猫) skin for the dsh Web GUI: #A3D3FF --dsw-static-*/--dsw-alias-* override set, full-screen wallpaper, frosted-glass sidebar/composer/code blocks and a settings-panel corner art, shipped as a self-contained dsh bundle+client plugin.
themes.notes: Confirmed --dsw-alias-* override set (deepseek/blue static scales + alias layers) and boot roster on 0.1.0-rc.6; a fresh main-UI boot stall was reported on one machine -- client.js payload was cut 440KB -> 238KB (wallpaper base64 deduped) in response, and a local no-cache fresh boot reaches the main chat UI, but the stall is not independently re-confirmed fixed. Hashed module-class overrides (frame/conversation/composer/settings) are pinned to 0.1.0-rc.6.
